# Biography.com

> > Comprehensive biographical profiles of notable figures across history, from literary masters like Miguel de Cervantes and Herman Melville to entertainers, political leaders, and cultural icons.

Biography.com provides in-depth life stories and historical context for influential people spanning literature, entertainment, politics, and beyond. Each profile explores the subject's major works, achievements, and lasting impact on culture and history.

- Golden Age Literature

- Literary History

## Authors & Writers

- [Miguel de Cervantes - Don Quixote, Books & Facts](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/miguel-de-cervantes): Spanish author Miguel de Cervantes, creator of Don Quixote masterpiece
- [Herman Melville - Books, Quotes & Moby Dick](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/herman-melville): American author Herman Melville, creator of Moby-Dick and sea adventures
- [Lois Lowry - Books, Age & Facts](https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/lois-lowry): Children's author Lois Lowry, known for The Giver and Number the Stars

## Actors & Entertainers

- [Sammy Davis Jr. - Children, Candy Man & Movies](https://www.biography.com/actors/sammy-davis-jr): Entertainer Sammy Davis Jr., Rat Pack member with Sinatra and Martin
- [Jon Voight](https://www.biography.com/actors/jon-voight): Actor Jon Voight's career from Midnight Cowboy to character roles

## Political Figures

- [Neville Chamberlain - WW2, Hitler & Appeasement](https://www.biography.com/political-figures/neville-chamberlain): British PM Neville Chamberlain's appeasement policy toward Nazi Germany
